papers.summary: Rarefied nonequilibrium flows are described by the Boltzmann equation, which can be solved using stochastic particle or deterministic methods. papers.title: A data-driven approach for morphological characterization and classification of flying inkjet droplets
papers.summary: We present a data-driven framework for the characterization of flying inkjet droplets based on a compact parametric representation of droplet contours.
